blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
. This paper addresses the challenge of automatic, frame-accurate event detection in table tennis videos. Current methods for estimating 3d ball trajectories and ball spin typically require that key events, such as ball-racket contacts, have already been identified in advance. This requirement makes it difficult to apply these methods to longer, unedited video recordings. To overcome this limitation, we propose EventNet, a two-stage pipeline to detect key events:
(1) 2d keypoints are extracted of the upper-body poses for both players, table corners and ball center. A small keypoint transformer combines them into a compact representation that is robust to changes in viewpoint, lighting, and background clutter. (2) The temporal sequences of these frame-based representations are processed by a transformer encoder that predicts two time-to-event values for each frame, indicating how close the current frame is to the next and previous ball-racket contact. One novelty is a new, temporal cosine-like target signal. Furthermore, we introduce viewpoint augmentation via 3D reprojection and frame-rate augmentation to improve robustness and generalization. Our extensive ablation study gives deeper insights into the importance of various architectural and training aspects. Experimental results show that the proposed approach achieves an F1 score of 91.16% and a mean frame deviation between ground truth and predicted frame of 0.42
on the Latte-MV dataset and 73.08% / 1.16 on the challenging TTHQ dataset.
Overall, our work demonstrates that 2d keypoint-based temporal modeling with
our EventNet architecture is a promising and practical approach for automatic event detection in table tennis videos.

blocks.en: 1. Introduction
blocks.zh: 1. 联合国 导言

blocks.en:
In table tennis, recent works ( Kienzle et al., 2026 ; Kienzle et al., 2025 ; Etaat et al., 2025 ) on 3d reconstruction and ball spin estimation have made it possible to analyze ball trajectories with high precision. However, these approaches usually assume that rallies are already segmented and timestamps of important events (such as ball-racket contacts or bounces on the table) are known in advance. In practice, this assumption is rarely satisfied, especially for long, uncut broadcast videos.
As a result, existing 3D trajectory and spin estimation pipelines cannot yet be applied fully automatically to such unedited broadcast videos.
blocks.zh:
在桌球方面,最近关于3d重建和球自旋估计的作品(Kienzle等,2026;Kienzle等,2025;Etaat等,2025.)使得能以高精度分析出球道. 然而,这些方法通常假定集会已经分出,重要事件的时间戳(如球架接触或桌上回弹等)是事先知道的. 在实践中,这种假设很少被满足,尤其是对于长而未剪接的广播视频.
因此,现有的3D轨迹和自旋估计管道还不能完全自动地适用于这种未经编辑的广播录像。

blocks.en: To address this limitation, this work focuses on automatic frame-accurate event detection such as ball-racket contact in table tennis videos using 2d keypoint representations instead of raw image data. We significantly extend and improve the work of ( Einfalt et al., 2019 ) on frame-accurate event detection of foot ground contact in long jump and triple jump using 2d keypoint sequences.
blocks.zh: 为解决这一限制,本作侧重于自动帧-精确事件检测,如使用2d键点表示而不是原始图像数据在桌球网球视频中的球架接触. 我们大幅扩展并改进了(Einfalt等,2019年)利用2d键点序列对长跳和三跳中脚地接触进行帧-精确事件检测的工作.

blocks.en: Our proposed approach follows a two-step pipeline: First, 2d keypoints are extracted for the ball, the table, and the players’ pose. The motion states of both players are represented through their upper body pose keypoints, the ball’s motion through its location, and the table keypoints provide geometric context. These keypoints in each frame are normalized and transformed by a keypoints transformer into a compact temporal sequence. Second, a time-to-event transformer then models the temporal dependencies in these sequences and predicts two time-to-event values for each frame, namely, how close a frame is to the previous and next event, which allows the model to locate ball-racket contact events in time precisely.
blocks.zh: 我们提议的办法是分两步进行: 首先,为球、桌和球员的姿势取出2d键。 双方球员的运动状态通过上身来代表出键点,球的动作通过位置来代表出键点,而表键点提供几何上下文. 每个帧中的这些键点被正常化并被一个键点变压器转化为紧凑的时间序列. 其次,一个时间对事件变换器然后模拟这些序列中的时间依赖性,并预测每个帧的两个时间对事件值,即一个帧与上个和下个事件有多相近,这使得模型能够准确定位球架接触事件.

blocks.en: Several extended and novel design choices beyond our baseline model ( Einfalt et al., 2019 ) are introduced to improve robustness, prediction performance, and generalization. Our key contributions are:
blocks.zh: 为改进稳健性、预测性能和概括性,在基线模型(Einfalt等,2019年)之外引入了若干扩展和新的设计选择。 我们的主要贡献是:

blocks.en: • The proposed fps augmentation makes our models insensitive to varying, unknown frame rates of input videos. • The proposed viewpoint augmentation through 3d reprojection mitigates the effect of the limited diversity of camera angles in the training dataset and simulates the complexity of real broadcast conditions. Both augmentations are possible due to our smart input representation as 2d keypoints without pixel information. • We propose a relative linear and cosine-like time-to-event encoding, instead of the absolute linear event encoding of ( Einfalt et al., 2019 ) . Both provide a smoother, more informative, and fps insensitive training signal. • The TCN backbone of ( Einfalt et al., 2019 ) is replaced with a transformer-based architecture. This improves event detection performance at reduced training time by a factor of 0.32 to 0.48. • An extensive ablation study gives deeper insights into the importance of various architectural and training aspects.

blocks.en: 2. Related Work
blocks.zh: 2. 相关工作

blocks.en: Previous work on event detection in sports videos can be roughly divided into three groups: methods that use (a) motion capture data, (b) work directly on raw video, or (c) rely on human poses and other keypoints as an intermediate representation.
blocks.zh: 体育录像中以往关于事件探测的工作大致可分为三组:使用(a)运动捕捉数据,(b)直接用生视频,或(c)依靠人姿势和其他关键点作为中间代表的方法.

blocks.en: Some early systems assume access to accurate 3D motion capture data ( Vicente et al., 2016 ; Fernández de Dios et al., 2013 ) . With special sensor- or marker-based setups, they detect key poses and split movements into actions, for example in martial arts or fitness exercises. These methods work well in controlled lab environments but need expensive hardware and are not suitable for large amounts of broadcast-like sports videos.
blocks.zh: 一些早期系统假设可以获取准确的3D运动捕捉数据(Vicente等,2016;Fernández de Dios等,2013.). 通过特殊的传感器或以标记为基础的设置,它们检测出关键姿势并分出动作,例如在武术或健身练习中. 这些方法在受控制的实验室环境中运作良好,但需要昂贵的硬件,并不适合大量广播等体育视频.

blocks.en: If only standard monocular videos are available, many approaches work directly on image or motion features ( Li et al., 2010 ; Wu et al., 2002 ) . Classical methods use silhouettes and motion-segmentation features for sports such as high diving or long jump, sometimes together with simple kinematic models. More recent deep learning methods train CNNs end-to-end on raw video frames to recognize actions or detect sparse events, for example in soccer or swimming ( Giancola et al., 2018 ; Sha et al., 2014 ; Victor et al., 2017 ; Woinoski et al., 2020 ) . These models do not need explicit motion representations, but they require a lot of annotated data and often generalize poorly when camera viewpoints or recording conditions change.
blocks.zh: 如果只有标准的单相机视频,许多方法直接处理图像或运动特征(Li等,2010;Wu等,2002.). 古典方法在高潜出或长跳等运动中使用了平滑和运动分块特征,有时与简单的运动模型一起使用. 较近期的深度学习方法在原始视频框上对CNN进行端到端的训练,以识别动作或检测稀有事件,如足球或游泳(Giancola等,2018;Sha等,2014;Victor等,2017;Woinoski等,2020.). 这些模型不需要明确的运动表示,但它们需要大量附加注释的数据,并且往往在相机观点或记录条件发生变化时被概括得很差.

blocks.en: A different line of work uses 2d human pose sequences as a compact description of motion ( Lienhart et al., 2018 ; Yagi et al., 2018 ; Einfalt et al., 2019 ) . It has been shown that even noisy 2d keypoints can be used to estimate step frequency in sprinting, split athletic movements into phases, and detect sparse events in athletics videos with convolutional sequence models. ( Einfalt and Lienhart, 2020 ) proposes to first estimate 2d poses with Mask R - CNN and then apply pose-based sequence models for event detection in swimming and athletics. Their results show that pose sequences allow accurate and data-efficient event detection and can be used in practical systems for different sports.
blocks.zh: 不同的一行工作使用2d人姿相序列作为运动的紧凑描述(Lienhart等,2018;Yagi等,2018;Einfalt等,2019). 已经证明,即使是吵闹的2d键点,也可以用来估计短跑中的步数频率,将运动运动分成相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 (Einfalt和Lienhart,2020年)提议首先用Mask R - 有线电视新闻网估计出2d的姿势,然后在游泳和田径比赛中应用以姿势为基础的测相模型。 其结果显示,姿势序列可以进行准确而有数据效率的事件检测,并可用于不同运动的实用系统.

blocks.en: This work follows the same general idea of separating visual perception from temporal reasoning, but focuses on table tennis. Compared to athletics and swimming, table tennis is more challenging because the ball is small, often occluded, filmed from many different viewpoints and moves fast.
blocks.zh: 本作沿用了将视觉感知与时间推理相分离的同一种一般想法,但专注于桌球. 与田径和游泳相比,桌球比较有挑战性,因为球很小,常常被围住,从许多不同的角度拍摄,动作快.

blocks.en: 3. Approach
blocks.zh: 3个 方针

blocks.en: Our goal is to perform frame-accurate event detection in video recordings of table tennis matches. As a representative event, we choose the moment of ball-racket contact, i.e., we want to predict all frames showing the desired event in long, unedited broadcast videos of table tennis matches. We assume that valid results of a 2d ball, table tennis corner and net detector, as well as a human pose estimator are available, providing us most of the time throughout a video with an estimate of the 2d pixel positions of the ball center, the table and net corners, as well as the keypoints of the torsos and upper limbs of both table tennis players 1 1 1 The source code and models are available at https://github.com/MLCVLab/EventNet .
blocks.zh: 我们的目标是在台网球比赛的录像中进行帧精确事件检测. 作为一个具有代表性的活动,我们选择了球架接触的瞬间,即我们想预测所有显示所希望的事件的帧,在桌球比赛的长而未经编辑的广播视频中. 我们假设2d球、桌球角和网球探测器以及人体姿势估测器的有效结果,在整个视频中为我们提供了大部分时间,估计了球中心、桌球和网球角的2d像素位置,以及桌球运动员的躯干和上肢的关键点。

blocks.en: 3.1. Baseline Model
blocks.zh: 3.1. 基线模型

blocks.en:
The work in ( Einfalt et al., 2019 ) serves as our baseline model. It addresses frame-accurate event detection in long and triple jump videos.
This method relies purely on 2d pose sequences extracted from the athlete in each frame to determine the beginning or end of foot ground contact. Pose sequences are a very compact and better suited representation for learning motion patterns over time than raw videos.
blocks.zh:
在(Einfalt等,2019年)中的工作是我们的基准模型。 它处理长相和三相跳跃视频中的帧-精确事件检测.
这种方法完全依靠从每个帧中从运动员身上提取出2d的姿势序列来确定脚地接触的开始或结束. 相较于原始视频,Pose序列是一个非常紧凑,更适合随时间演变的学习运动模式的表达.

blocks.en:
Adapted to our application scenario,
each frame is described by a concatenated vector of 2d keypoints consisting of the pixel positions of the ball center, the table and net corners as well as the keypoints of the torsos and upper limbs of both table tennis players. Keypoints without valid values for whatever reason (e.g., not in the field-of-view or the detector missed it) are encoded as NaN values. In ( Einfalt et al., 2019 ) the sequence of keypoints is fed into a fully T emporal C onvolutional N etwork (TCN ( Bai et al., 2018 ) ) that predicts the frame distance to the next and previous occurrence of the desired event type.
blocks.zh:
适应了我们的应用情景,
每个相框由由2d键点组成的凸起向量来描述,由球中心、桌和网角等像素位置以及桌网球运动员的躯干和上肢等键点组成。 无有效值的键点无论出于何种原因(例如,在视野中或探测器中没有被忽略)被编码为NaN值. 在(Einfalt等,2019年)中,键位的序列被输入到一个完全的timperal C on Evolutional N etwork(TCN(Bai等,2018年))中,预测到所希望的事件类型的下个和之前发生的帧距离.

blocks.en: A key contribution of ( Einfalt et al., 2019 ) is its event detection formulation. Instead of classifying each frame directly as event or non-event, it defines for every frame two target values for each event type: a forward and a backward time-to-event indicator value. The forward/backward value tells the network how far the current frame is away from the next/previous event. By predicting continuously time-to-event values (i.e., for every frame) instead of classifying a few rare events, a severe class imbalance at training time is avoided.
blocks.zh: (Einfalt等人,2019年)的一个关键贡献是其事件检测制剂. 它没有将每个帧直接归类为事件或非事件,而是为每个帧定义了每个事件类型的两个目标值:前向和后向时间对事件指标值. 向后/向后值告诉网络当前帧距离下个/上个事件有多远. 通过连续预测时间对事件值(即每个帧),而不是对少数罕见事件进行分类,避免了训练时严重的班级不平衡.

blocks.en: The TCN model ( Bai et al., 2018 ) is based on temporal convolutional blocks. Each block uses dilated 1D convolutions over time, followed by batch normalization, ReLU, dropout, and residual connections. The network takes flattened keypoint locations as input, and outputs the forward and backward timing indicators for all event types at each time step. During training, the input length is set to the model’s receptive field, and the prediction is made for the center frame of the sequence. At inference time, the network processes the full pose sequence of a video and predicts time-to-event indicator values for every frame. Event locations are detected at time steps t t where both indicator values simultaneously identify the same frame as the next and previous event.
blocks.zh: TCN模型(Bai等,2018年)基于时间分解块. 每个区块都使用随时间推移而膨胀的一维分流,然后是批量正常化,ReLU,退学和剩余连接. 网络采用平整后的关键点位置作为输入,并在每个时段输出所有事件类型的前向和后向时间指标. 在训练期间,输入长度被设定到模型的可接受字段,对序列的中框进行预测. 在推论时间,网络处理一个视频的全部姿势序列并预测每个帧的时间对事件的指标值. 事件位置在时间步 t t 时被检测出,两个指标值同时识别出与下个事件和上个事件相同的框架.

In our EventNet, we replace the TCN from the baseline model ( Einfalt et al., 2019 ) with an encoder-only transformer architecture. It consists of a Keypoints Transformer which converts the sequence of 2d keypoints for each frame into a compact per-frame embedding, and a Time-to-Event Transformer which models the temporal evolution of these embeddings to predict the values of the time-to-event indicators f ⁡ ( t ) f(t) and b ⁡ ( t ) b(t) for time instances t t .
Fig. 1 illustrates this architecture.
The input to EventNet is a tensor 𝐱 ∈ ℝ T × N × 2 \mathbf{x}\in\mathbb{R}^{T\times N\times 2} , where T T denotes the number of frames in the sequence, and N N the number of 2d keypoints per frame (see Fig. 3 ), and the last dimension provides the normalized ( x , y ) (x,y) coordinates of each keypoint.

Since some frames may have missing keypoints, represented as NaN values, these coordinates are handled explicitly
by the Keypoints Transformer as illustrated in Fig. 4 top.
For each frame, a binary mask marks all keypoints with NaN coordinates as missing.
Then, each of the N N keypoints is projected linearly to a latent dimension D D . The result is masked again so that no missing keypoint can contribute to the representation. To obtain a fixed-size representation of the keypoints for each frame, a learnable CLS token is appended to the keypoint sequence. The resulting sequence of N + 1 N+1 keypoints is processed by a small stack of two transformer encoder blocks with multihead self-attention. Again, the attention is masked to ensure that NaN keypoints do not influence the self-attention at all. After the encoder, only the CLS output token is retained for each frame as the compact descriptor of the entire keypoint set at time t t . blocks.en:
The summarized representation of 2d keypoints, obtained as CLS token sequence 𝐳 \mathbf{z} ,
is then passed to the Time-to-Event Transformer, shown in Fig. 5 . Here, a stack of three transformer encoder blocks models dependencies across time using multi-head self-attention, residual connections, pre-norm layer normalization, and a position-wise feed-forward network with ReLU activation 3 3 3 In the experimental results section, we will also explore the effect of replacing ReLU by GELU or the whole FFN-block by SwiGLUFFN. .
In this stage, the model captures long-range temporal context across the sequence of per-frame CLS tokens and maps them frame-wise to forward and backward time-to-event indicators. A final linear layer projects each temporal embedding to the 2d output values corresponding to the predicted f ⁡ ( t ) f(t) and b ⁡ ( t ) b(t) signals. As the prediction targets depend only on the nearest neighboring events, the model is trained on fixed-length sequences and predicts timing indicators for the central time step m = ⌊ T / 2 ⌋ m=\lfloor T/2\rfloor . blocks.en: 4.1. Datasets
blocks.zh: 4.1. 数据集

blocks.en:
All configurations of our approach were trained and evaluated on the Latte-MV dataset ( Etaat et al., 2025 ) . The dataset provides annotations of racket-ball contacts as well as 2d and 3d keypoint annotations for ball, tennis table, and human poses of both players. It consists of 9,803 training, 2,099 validation, and 2,103 test videos. In case of viewpoint augmentation using 3D reprojection, the augmentation strategy was only applied to a subset of 2,328 training and 498 validation videos, for which the 3d ball coordinates were valid (i.e., not showing NaN values) at least 70% of all frames. The remaining training and validation videos were used without augmentations. For fps augmentation, the frame rates varied between 30 and 60 fps. The test set was never unchanged. The keypoint annotations
were rescaled to a resolution of 1920 × 1080 1920\times 1080 before training. Models were trained on a sequence length of T = 29 T=29 , each configuration 3 times with 3 different seeds.

blocks.en:
The TTHQ dataset ( Kienzle et al., 2026 ) was used to assess the model on real-world table tennis footage recorded from very diverse viewpoints and a wide variety of scenes. All videos consist of standard or semi-broadcast YouTube content, captured at a resolution of 1920 × 1080 1920\times 1080 with a static camera setup per video. The frame rates range from 25 to 60 fps. From the TTHQ dataset, we only select videos containing two players, as our models are trained on two-player scenes. The final selection consists of six long videos, which were split into shorter clips and recorded under varying camera viewpoints and frame rates, resulting in a total of 56 clips.
TTHQ provides annotations of ball-racket contacts and tennis table corners, but not for the 2d poses of the two players and only some for ball positions. Therefore, the players were first localized in each video frame using RT-DETRv2 ( Lv et al., 2024 ) (model rtdetr_r50vd_coco_o365 4 4 4 https://github.com/lyuwenyu/RT-DETR ). Then, since table tennis involves two players in our setup, our algorithm selects the two largest detected persons in each frame, followed by 2d pose estimation using a ViT-Pose-B model ( Xu et al., 2022 ) (model vitpose-base-simple 5 5 5 https://github.com/ViTAE-Transformer/ViTPose ).
To ensure consistent player assignment across a video, the two detected players are ordered in the input keypoints vector based on their spatial position relative to the table net (see Fig. 6 ). First, the front-mid and back-mid table keypoints construct a line representing the table net. Next, the center point of each detected player is computed from his/her bounding box. The sign of the cross product between the net direction vector and the vector from the front-mid net point to each player determines whether a player is located on the “left” or “right” side of the table.
blocks.zh:
TTHQ数据集(Kienzle等,2026年)被用来评估从非常多样的观点和各种场景所录入的现实世界乒乓球镜头上的模型. 所有视频由标准或半广播的YouTube内容组成,以1920×1080 1920\times 1080的分辨率被捕获,每段视频都有静态相机设置. 帧率从25到60英尺不等. 从TTHQ数据集中,我们只选择包含两个玩家的视频,因为我们的模型都接受了双玩家场景的培训. 最终选择由6个长相相片组成,被分成更短的相片片段并收录在相机视线和相框速率上,共计56个相片段.
TTHQ提供球架接触和网球桌角的注释,但不针对两名球员的2d姿势,而只针对球位. 因此,玩家先是使用RT-DETRv2(Lv等,2024年)(型号为rtetr_r50vd_coco_o365 4 4 4 https://github.com/lyuwenyu/RT-DETR )在每一相框中本地化. 然后,由于桌球的设置中有两个玩家,我们的算法选择了每个相框中被检测出的最大两个人,然后是使用ViT-Pose-B模型进行2d的平面估计(Xu等,2022年)(型号为vitpose-bas-simp 5 5 https://github.com/VitAE-Transfor/ViTPose).
为确保在视频中始终如一地分配玩家,在输入键点向量中根据相对于表网的空间位置对被检测出的两个玩家进行订购(见图6). 首先,前中后中表键点构造出一行代表表网. 接下来,每个被检测到的玩家的中心点都是从其边框中计算出. 网向向量和从前中网点到每个玩家的向量之间的交叉产物的标志,决定玩家是位于表格"左"还是"右"一面.

blocks.en:
From the full set of predicted pose keypoints, only a subset relevant to the upper body is used. These are: head, left/right shoulder, left/right elbow, left/right wrist, and left/right hip .
Thus, each player is represented by nine 2d keypoints.
The table and ball were detected in each frame using a SegFormer++ B0 model ( Xie et al., 2021 ; Kienzle et al., 2024 ) , a lightweight transformer-based segmentation model. It provides efficient and accurate per-frame segmentation, which makes it suitable for detecting small objects such as the ball and for localizing the table tennis table consistently across video frames.

因此,每个玩家由9个2d键来代表.

blocks.zh: 4.2. 结构细节

blocks.en:
The temporal transformer was trained with a default batch size of 200 for 30 epochs. The model parameters are optimized using the Adam optimizer. The initial learning rate is set to 5 ⋅ 10 − 4 5\cdot 10^{-4} , and a learning rate scheduler is used to improve convergence by reducing the learning rate by a factor of γ = 0.3 \gamma=0.3 after epoch 2, allowing the models to fine-tune their weights with smaller updates in later training stages. Formally, the learning rate at epoch t t is given by lr t = γ k ⋅ lr \text{lr}_{t}=\gamma^{k}\cdot\text{lr} ,
where k k is the number of milestones reached (in this case, k = 1 k=1 after epoch 2). This scheduling strategy helps to stabilize training and improve overall performance.

This approach stabilizes training by reducing the effect of noisy gradient updates and improves evaluation and inference performance.

Two encoder layers with a classification token of dimension d = 128 d=128 were used to process keypoints. The time-to-event transformer uses three encoder layers, and the output consists of two predicted values per frame: f ^ ​ ( t ) \hat{f}(t) (predicted forward timing indicator) and b ^ ​ ( t ) \hat{b}(t) (predicted backward timing indicator).
The combined event indicator r ^ ​ ( t ) \hat{r}(t) was used for discrete event extraction as described in Section 3.5,
with non-maximum suppression applied using a window size of w = 7 w=7 frames and a minimal peak height of 0.5 0.5 .

blocks.en: 4.3. Evaluation metrics
blocks.zh: 4.3. 评价指标

blocks.en: For evaluation, we let a trained model process a complete test video set to predict all ball-racket contact events. We assign to each ground truth event in the test set the closest predicted event if and only if it is within an absolute temporal distance of Δ ​ t \Delta t frames. Thus, a predicted event is considered correct if (a) its absolute temporal distance to the assigned ground truth does not exceed the maximum allowed frame distance Δ ​ t \Delta t and (b) there is no other closer predicted event. In our experiments, we have chosen a default threshold of Δ ​ t = 3 \Delta t=3 frames.
blocks.zh: 为了评估,我们让一个训练有素的模型过程 一个完整的测试视频集 来预测所有的球架接触事件。 我们在测试中为每个地面真相事件指定了最接近的预测事件,条件是并且只有在绝对时间距离=t\Delta t框架之内。 因此,如果(a)它与指定地面真理的绝对时间相距不超过允许的最大帧相距 * t\Delta t并(b)没有其他更接近的预测相距,则预测的事件被认为是正确的. 在我们的实验中,我们选择了一个默认阈值为 QQ t = 3\Delta t = 3帧.

blocks.en:
Having defined what correct event detections are, we can now compute precision, recall , and F1 score (in percentage) over a complete test video dataset. The F1 score is the harmonic mean of precision and recall. Instead of a simple average, a harmonic mean punishes extreme failures. Thus, F1 will be our main performance score.
Additionally, the mean absolute frame deviation (short L1 Diff ) of all correctly detected events (i.e., true positives) is also reported. A value of, for instance, 0.5 means that on average the error is 1/2 of a frame.
blocks.zh:

blocks.zh: 4.4. 实验结果和缺陷研究

blocks.en: In this section, we systematically evaluate each proposed component and its various implementation options. The experiments are structured to validate our key design choices and demonstrate its performance. In table tennis, the ball isn’t always easy to see or visible. Therefore, one idea was to use the players’ upper-body joints as reference keypoints to help determine the timing of the ball-racket contact more reliably and, potentially, more accurately.
We tested therefore whether the keypoint set UB outperforms the keypoints set NO. Table 1 gives here a clear answer. If the focus is on the best performing configuration using mask tokens for NaN values and averaging over all time-to-event signal and FFN variants, we see that NO outperforms UB by 2.31% (88.59 vs. 86.28) on Latte-MV and by 2.12% (69.09 vs. 66.97) on TTHQ. Similar results can be determined for the choice of mask NaN values. Note also that the average L1 difference is slightly lower for keypoint set NO than UB. Thus, body pose does not help in our specific event detection task. Probably, the reversal of the ball’s direction provides the clearest signal for the example event detection task chosen.

Contrary to expectations, fps augmentation does not consistently help. While it is clear that it should slightly degrade the performance on Latte-MV with consistent 30 fps videos, it only shows its benefit on TTHQ if combined with viewpoint augmentation. Here, the F1 score of 61.0% without any augmentation increases to 70.5% with viewpoint augmentations and further absolute 3.2 points to 73.8% by adding also fps augmentations. Thus, viewpoint augmentations are highly effective to adapt to different viewpoints, while fps augmentation needs viewpoint augmentations to show its benefit.

blocks.en: 5. Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 (韩语). 结论

blocks.en:
We have presented a practical approach to event detection in table
tennis that combines compact 2D keypoint representations with transformer-based temporal modeling. In contrast to relying on raw video input directly, 2D keypoints are very efficient and generalize to diverse environmental settings very well. Therefore, EventNet is a modular solution for sports analysis in challenging video settings.
blocks.zh:
我们在表格中提出了发现事件的实用方法
网球结合了紧凑的2D键点表示和以变压器为基础的时间模型. 与直接依赖原始视频输入形成对比的是,2D键位非常高效并非常通俗地归纳到多样的环境环境. 因此,EventNet是挑战性视频环境下的体育分析模块解决方案.

blocks.en: Several central findings were discovered in this work. (1) A smartly designed small transformer-based architecture (using a keypoint and a time-to-event encoder) outperforms (speed- and performance-wise) a temporal convolutional network (TCN) substantially. (2) If the training data set is recorded at a fixed fps, the proposed fps data augmentation and a relative temporal time-to-event indicator signal (either relative linear or cosine-like) can transfer to variable fps rates of test videos. (3) If the training data set is recorded from a fixed camera view, the proposed viewpoint augmentation and a relative temporal time-to-event indicator signal can transfer to variable viewpoints of test videos. However, there are viewpoint cases where the event is not visible and therefore the overall temporal precision suffers (e.g., frontal views in table tennis). (4) The upper body pose of the table tennis player did not help in the case of ball-racket contact estimation, except in cases where the ball is not visible such as for frontal view recordings. In all other cases, the upper body pose degraded the temporal precision in time as the ball - if visible - is the best indicator for identifying the point of time when the ball changes its direction. Despite that we focus on racket-ball contact in this paper, our approach is transferable to all kinds of motion event detection.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中发现了一些核心结论。 (1)智能设计的以变压器为主的小型变压器架构(使用键位和时间到事件编码器)大大超过(从速度和性能上看)时间演化网络(TCN). (2)如果训练数据集被记录在一个固定的fps中,则拟议的fps数据增强和相对的时间-时间对事件指标信号(无论是相对的线性信号还是类似余弦信号)可以转移到测试视频的可变fps率. (3)如果从固定相机角度记录培训数据集,则拟议的观点增强和相对时间-时间-事件指标信号可以转移到测试视频的可变观点. 然而,有些观点认为事件不明显,因此总体时间精确度受到影响(例如表网球中的正面观点)。 (4)桌球选手的上身姿势在球架接触估计中无济于事,但球前取景录音等不可见的情况除外. 在所有其他情况下,上体会使时间精度在时间上退化,因为球——如果可以看见的话——是确定球改变方向的时间点的最佳指标. 尽管我们在本文中着重讨论球拍接触问题,但我们的方法可以转用于各种运动事件探测。
